message.content:
Black wool overcoat, classic cut reaching mid-calf length, charcoal grey, heavy worsted wool.
Charcoal grey tailored trousers, straight-leg silhouette with a sharp crease, knee-length hem, fine twill fabric.
Ivory white high-collar button-up shirt, relaxed yet structured fit, chest-down length, crisp cotton poplin.
Dark brown leather loafers, sleek slip-on design, ankle-high coverage, full-grain calfskin leather.
Black silk pocket square, square fold style, long tail draping over the jacket, lustrous satin weave.

This ensemble strikes a respectful balance between solemnity and dignity for an autumn morning funeral service. The charcoal tones of the coat and trousers offer a somber yet refined aesthetic appropriate for mourning traditions, while the ivory shirt adds a necessary touch of brightness to the dark palette. A brown leather loafer replaces the black often associated with funerals, providing a subtle personal warmth without violating the strict dress code expectations. Finally, the silk pocket square serves as a discreet focal point that honors the deceased with elegance rather than overwhelming grandeur.
